literal.prompt: Какой коренной народ традиционно живёт в Гренландии, на севере Канады и Аляски?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The stem asks for an Indigenous people whose traditional range spans Greenland, northern Canada and Alaska. ICC identifies Inuit in Alaska, Canada and Greenland (L65) and calls these Inuit Nunaat/homelands (L67). Arctic Council identifies the Sámi Council as representing people in Norway, Sweden, Finland and Russia (L191), supporting a plausible neighboring Indigenous distractor. The supplied Nenets and Chukchi labels are also regionally plausible Arctic peoples, but their attached location claims are not certified here because the attempted Russian profile had no body and its official alternative returned 403; this literal group remains HOLD.
literalGroups.locator: ICC L65-L67; Arctic Council History L191; Russian-profile exact evidence unavailable.
